sections.markdown:
## C2 — Licensing eligibility, identification and tests
FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
Restriction A limits driving to an automatic transmission. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
Restriction B requires corrective lenses. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
Restriction C indicates a required mechanical aid. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A01
Restriction D indicates a required prosthetic aid. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A01
Restriction G limits driving to daylight. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A01
Restriction I is labeled as a limitation covering other circumstances. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A01
Restriction J marks a license valid without a photograph or signature. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A01
Restriction R limits operation to a four-wheel recreational vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A02
A person who fails vision screening must obtain a vision statement from an eye specialist. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A02
Glasses or contact lenses used to pass vision screening must also be used while driving. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A02
An applicant whose visual acuity is worse than 20/40 but at least 20/100 must take a driving-skills test. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A03
The written exam draws its questions from the information in the Wyoming driver manual. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A03
Written testing includes recognition of traffic signs by their shape, color or symbol. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A03
Signals and pavement markings are subjects of the written test. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R15 | anchor: A03
Written multiple-choice questions address traffic laws, safety rules, crash prevention and vehicle equipment. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R16 | anchor: A03
A driver-license applicant may take the written test at most twice during one day. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R17 | anchor: A03
Although tests are given only in English, an interpreter may be used when an applicant cannot speak or write English. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R18 | anchor: A03
An applicant seeking an oral test must request it before testing. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R19 | anchor: A03
A first-time applicant never licensed in Wyoming or any other state must pass a skills test of safe driving maneuvers. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R20 | anchor: A03
The skills test does not require an applicant to perform an illegal maneuver. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R21 | anchor: A03
Other circumstances may require a driving test to demonstrate driving ability. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R22 | anchor: A03
A skills-test applicant who fails must wait 24 hours before trying again. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R23 | anchor: A03
An approved driver-education completion certification card may allow the skills test to be waived. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R24 | anchor: A03
The driver-education certification card must list the student's name, birth date and driver-license number. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R25 | anchor: A03
The certification card must carry the instructor's and school administrator's original signatures. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R26 | anchor: A03
The certification card must confirm 30 classroom hours and six hours of behind-the-wheel instruction. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R27 | anchor: A03
A driver-education certification card is honored for no more than two years. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0009]
